name: s3
purpose: Short documents (the 24 check-1 documents): the best method so far (200 DPI + text layer) against 250 DPI, an instruction to copy values verbatim, and an instruction on reading check boxes.

methods.name: 200+text+verbatim
methods.user_instruction: Extract every field from the attached document according to the schema. Return JSON only. Use null for fields not present in the document. Whenever the schema declares a list field, enumerate every row visible in the document - do not collapse rows or return an empty list when rows are present. Copy each value exactly as it is printed (same spelling, punctuation and capitalization); do not add units, labels or footnote marks that are not part of the value.

methods.name: 200+text+checkbox
methods.user_instruction: Extract every field from the attached document according to the schema. Return JSON only. Use null for fields not present in the document. Whenever the schema declares a list field, enumerate every row visible in the document - do not collapse rows or return an empty list when rows are present. A check-box field is true only when its box is visibly marked (an X, a tick or a filled box) and false when the box is empty.
